codekin.flavor: A spark that climbed out of a café menu and refused to go out. Its crest flickers brighter whenever someone scans nearby.
codekin.name: Emberkit

codekin.flavor: Its flame horns curl forward when it's ready to battle. Codes it guards stay warm to the touch.
codekin.name: Blazefang

codekin.flavor: When it spreads its wings of fire, the whole block glows. It only lands on codes scanned a thousand times.
codekin.name: Pyrevix

codekin.flavor: A drop of water that learned to hold its shape. It leaves tiny wet footprints on every code it visits.
codekin.name: Driplet

codekin.flavor: Wears a breaking wave like a hood, and can hold it for hours without spilling a drop.
codekin.name: Tidewyrm

codekin.flavor: A whirlpool turns around its waist wherever it goes. Fountains rise to greet it.
codekin.name: Leviathorn

codekin.flavor: A seed of light that sprouted from a garden-center code. Its leaves follow the sun, or your phone's flashlight.
codekin.name: Sproutle

codekin.flavor: Grows a new thorn for every code it outgrows. The leaves on its back rustle when it's pleased.
codekin.name: Thornback

codekin.flavor: Roots itself beside a code and grows a canopy overhead. Smaller elementals nap in its shade.
codekin.name: Arborok

codekin.flavor: A pepper-shaped flame that lives in takeout menus. It hiccups sparks when it's surprised.
codekin.name: Chilibean

codekin.flavor: Glows like a paper lantern stuffed with heat. It challenges hot sauce bottles and always wins.
codekin.name: Habanerok

codekin.flavor: Crowns itself ruler of every spice rack it finds. Its cape of flame trails sparks on the way out.
codekin.name: Capsicrown

codekin.flavor: Its tail flame sputters when it's sad and roars back when it's happy. Warm laptops are its favorite bed.
codekin.name: Sizzlet

codekin.flavor: Fans out its frills of flame when it's excited, which is most of the time.
codekin.name: Frillflare

codekin.flavor: Rides the heat rising off rooftops and chimneys. Its cry sounds like a kettle about to boil.
codekin.name: Scaldwing

codekin.flavor: Floats in a cup of its own making and steams gently. It only turns up at café codes.
codekin.name: Brewbie

codekin.flavor: Roasts coffee beans along its back all day. By evening the whole street smells wonderful.
codekin.name: Mochaflare

codekin.flavor: A matchstick of living flame. It flares up when startled and dims around puddles.
codekin.name: Matchlet

codekin.flavor: Carries a torch that has never gone out, lighting the way for anyone lost after dark.
codekin.name: Flarebrand

codekin.flavor: A clay pot with a fire inside. Hands that hold it stay warm for hours.
codekin.name: Kilnkin

codekin.flavor: A walking furnace that bakes little pottery gifts. Its chimney puffs a smoke ring when it's proud.
codekin.name: Furnox

codekin.flavor: Wears a helmet made from the first stone it ever melted through. It tunnels under parking lots for fun.
codekin.name: Magmound

codekin.flavor: A cloud of cooled lava with curled horns. When it charges, the cracks glow white-hot.
codekin.name: Cindercurl

codekin.flavor: Appears after rainstorms and jumps into every puddle it can find. Fountains are its favorite place.
codekin.name: Splashlet

codekin.flavor: Cuts through the water with a lance of pure current. It balances beach balls on the tip for fun.
codekin.name: Wavelance

codekin.flavor: Floats out of fountains and soap dispensers. If it laughs too hard it pops, then reforms a moment later.
codekin.name: Bubblet

codekin.flavor: Drifts over harbors at night, flickering like a lantern. Its sting tickles more than it hurts.
codekin.name: Jellumina

codekin.flavor: Rules a glittering swarm of jellies. When it crackles, every streetlight along the pier blinks.
codekin.name: Medusire

codekin.flavor: Carries a spiral shell from a beach-shop code. It hides inside when strangers scan it.
codekin.name: Shellby

codekin.flavor: Wears a stone cap it carved itself and won't take it off, not even to sleep.
codekin.name: Capstone

codekin.flavor: Gives orders to every tide pool in a booming voice. Its big claw can crack a coconut.
codekin.name: Capitan

codekin.flavor: Peeks out of its shell to see who scanned it, then snaps shut if they look too eager.
codekin.name: Clamber

codekin.flavor: Every pearl it grows holds a reflection of the day it was made. It keeps them all orbiting close.
codekin.name: Pearlord

codekin.flavor: Wears a lily pad for a hat and hums at the start of every shower.
codekin.name: Lilyplop

codekin.flavor: The little raincloud above it follows it everywhere. When it sulks, the cloud starts to drizzle.
codekin.name: Drizzlord

codekin.flavor: Leaps up fountains at first light. Whoever sees its fins catch the sun has luck all day.
codekin.name: Glimmerfin

codekin.flavor: Carries a tiny garden on its spiral shell. It is never in a hurry, about anything, ever.
codekin.name: Mosscurl

codekin.flavor: Carries a little pond on its back, cattails and all. Dragonflies follow it across the park.
codekin.name: Moorshell

codekin.flavor: Pops up overnight after rain. Pat its cap and it puffs out a sleepy cloud of glowing spores.
codekin.name: Sporelet

codekin.flavor: Smaller mushrooms keep sprouting on its shoulders. It's very proud of them.
codekin.name: Shroomble

codekin.flavor: Its roots reach under the whole park. It knows the moment anyone steps off the path.
codekin.name: Mycelord

codekin.flavor: Keeps its petals closed until it trusts you. A sunny windowsill is its idea of paradise.
codekin.name: Budling

codekin.flavor: Flits between flower boxes leaving a trail of sparkles. Bees think it's the best flower in town.
codekin.name: Blossomire

codekin.flavor: Dances in public gardens at dawn. Wherever its petal skirt brushes the ground, flowers open.
codekin.name: Florabelle

codekin.flavor: Looks like a fallen leaf until the wind blows the others away and it stays put.
codekin.name: Leaflit

codekin.flavor: Its arms are as sharp as grass blades. It bows politely before every battle.
codekin.name: Scytheleaf

codekin.flavor: A ball of thorns that only wants a hug. Very few people are brave enough.
codekin.name: Prickit

codekin.flavor: Stands guard with its arms raised for days at a time. Lost hikers use it as a landmark.
codekin.name: Saguardian

codekin.flavor: Only comes out once the sun is low. It rolls downhill on purpose and giggles the whole way.
codekin.name: Pumpkid

codekin.flavor: Walks the streets at night with a candle burning in its head, lighting the way home.
codekin.name: Gourdian

codekin.flavor: Curls up beside tea menus. Its tail froths like a whisk and smells faintly of matcha.
codekin.name: Matchawisp

codekin.flavor: Gathers around Wi-Fi routers to snack on stray signals. Its antennae crackle when it sneezes.
codekin.name: Zapling

codekin.flavor: Charges so fast it leaves the smell of a thunderstorm behind. Streetlights flicker as it passes.
codekin.name: Voltusk

codekin.flavor: When a group of them races by, the sky answers with thunder. Its tusks hum like power lines.
codekin.name: Tuskstorm

codekin.flavor: Naps under porch lights. Its tail glows brighter the more power it has sipped.
codekin.name: Sparkcoil

codekin.flavor: Drawn to screens and porch lights. The spots on its wings blink in patterns nobody can decode.
codekin.name: Flickerwisp

codekin.flavor: Plugs its tail into the wall when it's tired. It wiggles so hard the lights flicker.
codekin.name: Pluglet

codekin.flavor: Guards server rooms at night. Its collar crackles a warning before it ever has to fight.
codekin.name: Wattwarden

codekin.flavor: Lights up whenever it has a good idea. It has a lot of good ideas.
codekin.name: Bulblet

codekin.flavor: Wears a lampshade at a jaunty angle and reads by its own light long after bedtime.
codekin.name: Lampkin

codekin.flavor: Floats above ballrooms and theaters. Its crystals scatter rainbows across every wall.
codekin.name: Filamentor

codekin.flavor: Winds itself up every morning. If its key stops turning, it sits and waits for help.
codekin.name: Gizmite

codekin.flavor: A clockwork giant of stone and brass. Its chest gear ticks steadily, like a heartbeat.
codekin.name: Gearhulk

codekin.flavor: Its copper quills catch static from carpets. Petting it is a shocking experience.
codekin.name: Spikit

codekin.flavor: Climbs to rooftops in storms and raises its quills to the sky. Lightning always finds it.
codekin.name: Quillvolt

codekin.flavor: Only flutters near Wi-Fi codes. The arcs over its head show how strong the signal is.
codekin.name: Wifly

codekin.flavor: Mistaken for a garden rock until it waddles off. It polishes its crystal every morning.
codekin.name: Pebblit

codekin.flavor: Ancient crystals grow along its back. A single stomp registers on earthquake sensors.
codekin.name: Bouldron

codekin.flavor: Sleeps for years at a time and wakes up as a new hill. The crystal in its chest still glows.
codekin.name: Colossite

codekin.flavor: Looks like a plain rock until it sneezes and its crystals ring like little bells.
codekin.name: Shardlet

codekin.flavor: Grows a new crystal every full moon. It hums quietly while they come in.
codekin.name: Quartzel

codekin.flavor: Sits like royalty on a throne of its own crystals. Light passing through them turns violet.
codekin.name: Amethrone

codekin.flavor: Curls into a ball and rolls away whenever it's startled, which is often.
codekin.name: Rollbit

codekin.flavor: Bores tunnels under the city with its spinning drill. Subway crews leave it snacks.
codekin.name: Drillstone

codekin.flavor: Swam in seas that dried up long ago. Nobody knows how it woke up, least of all Ammolet.
codekin.name: Ammolet

codekin.flavor: Its spiral shell keeps a record of every year it has lived. It has a great many years.
codekin.name: Ammonarch

codekin.flavor: Wags its plated tail so hard when it's happy that it knocks itself over.
codekin.name: Plateling

codekin.flavor: Moss grows on its stone plates, and small flowers in the moss. It wanders slowly through parks.
codekin.name: Platelith

codekin.flavor: Perches on old buildings pretending to be a statue. At night it stretches and goes exploring.
codekin.name: Gargoling

codekin.flavor: Rolls a little ball of sunlight wherever it goes. Its shell shimmers green, then gold.
codekin.name: Sunroller

codekin.flavor: Rides updrafts between rooftops. It carries messages for anyone who shares a crumb.
codekin.name: Gustling

codekin.flavor: Every beat of its wings stirs a tiny cyclone. Pilots report it racing jets for fun.
codekin.name: Cyclonix

codekin.flavor: Patrols the skyline at sunset on enormous wings, and lands only on the tallest buildings.
codekin.name: Galecrest

codekin.flavor: Stays up all night and naps through the day. It can turn its head almost all the way around.
codekin.name: Hushling

codekin.flavor: Flies without a sound under the moon. The crescent on its chest glows brighter at midnight.
codekin.name: Nocturnis

codekin.flavor: Tugs at the wind on breezy days. If you let go, it comes back by itself.
codekin.name: Kitelet

codekin.flavor: Glides for hours on the wind off the beach, its ribbon tail snapping like applause.
codekin.name: Kitewing

codekin.flavor: Dances over festivals and parades. Children cheer, and it loops the crowd once more.
codekin.name: Dragonkite

codekin.flavor: Its wings beat so fast they hum a note. Each Hummbit hums a slightly different one.
codekin.name: Hummbit

codekin.flavor: Visits every flower box in the neighborhood before breakfast. Its streamers smell of spring.
codekin.name: Zephyrra

codekin.flavor: Hangs around boardwalks waiting for someone to drop a fry. Nobody ever does.
codekin.name: Gusthop

codekin.flavor: Its wings are as wide as a sail. It follows ships across the ocean and never seems tired.
codekin.name: Galeon

codekin.flavor: A paper crane that folded itself out of a flyer's code. They say a thousand of them can grant a wish.
codekin.name: Cranefold

codekin.flavor: Leaps from park trees and glides from branch to branch. It never touches the ground.
codekin.name: Glidrel

codekin.flavor: Hangs from porches and sings whenever the wind passes. Its song changes with the weather.
codekin.name: Chimelet

codekin.flavor: Hides in the shadow under your bed and hums lullabies. Surprisingly bad at being scary.
codekin.name: Shadeling

codekin.flavor: Half shadow, half mischief. It follows people home at a polite distance and pretends it isn't.
codekin.name: Shadelurk

codekin.flavor: Stitched together from midnight. Only its glowing eyes give away where it's watching from.
codekin.name: Umbrawl

codekin.flavor: Hangs upside down under bridges and squeaks at passing bikes. It only wants to say hello.
codekin.name: Duskbit

codekin.flavor: Sweeps through the city at dusk in a cloak of shadow. It has excellent manners and a terrible laugh.
codekin.name: Vespire

codekin.flavor: Washes everything it finds before eating it, including things that are not food.
codekin.name: Masklet

codekin.flavor: Rules the alleys after midnight with a trash-can lid for a shield. Every bin on the block is its kingdom.
codekin.name: Rummagrim

codekin.flavor: Spins tiny webs in mailbox corners. In the morning they're full of dew and look like lace.
codekin.name: Spinnet

codekin.flavor: Weaves webs that catch bad dreams. Moss and mushrooms grow on its back while it waits.
codekin.name: Gloomweaver

codekin.flavor: Leaves little ink footprints across every page it walks on. It's trying to write something.
codekin.name: Inklet

codekin.flavor: Its ink clouds are so dark that light gets lost in them. Sailors tell stories, all of them true.
codekin.name: Inkraken

codekin.flavor: Turns up at shop and package codes. Nobody remembers ordering it, and it was never returned.
codekin.name: Parcelgeist

codekin.flavor: Lives where sunlight never reaches. Its lure glows in colors nobody has names for.
codekin.name: Lurelight

codekin.flavor: Splits sunlight into rainbows to talk. Groups of them are mistaken for disco balls.
codekin.name: Prismite

codekin.flavor: Its crystal spots catch the morning light. It's shy, but it always comes back.
codekin.name: Gleamlet

codekin.flavor: Its crystal antlers hum a single clear note. Lost travelers follow its glow home.
codekin.name: Lumenox

codekin.flavor: Nibbles flower petals and glows the same color as whatever it ate last.
codekin.name: Lumicrawl

codekin.flavor: Sleeps inside a shell of crystal, dreaming in colors. Light pours out through the cracks.
codekin.name: Chrysalux

codekin.flavor: Its wings shimmer like the northern lights. Wherever it lands, the colors linger.
codekin.name: Aurorawing

codekin.flavor: Practices fanning its tiny tail in shop windows. It is very pleased with what it sees.
codekin.name: Pavlet

codekin.flavor: When it opens its tail, every eye on it glows. Crowds gather and forget why they came.
codekin.name: Pavonix

codekin.flavor: Carved from an ice cube and proud of it. It refuses to go anywhere warm and naps in freezers.
codekin.name: Cubic

codekin.flavor: The ice crystals on its back split sunlight into rainbows. On snowy days you can see it for miles.
codekin.name: Polarize

codekin.flavor: A pet projected from an app nobody remembers installing. It flickers when it's nervous.
codekin.name: Holobit

codekin.flavor: A hand mirror with a mind of its own. It shows you as you'd like to be, which is very kind of it.
codekin.name: Reflectra

codekin.flavor: A blaze of noon on wings of fire. It circles above stadiums and festivals while the crowd is loudest.
codekin.name: Solarch
codekin.rumor: Spotted near events & tickets at midday or dusk, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: An ancient tide that carries a sunken island on its back. The sea rises wherever it surfaces.
codekin.name: Tidalisk
codekin.rumor: Spotted near waterside at dawn, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: The old forest's keeper. Its antlers bloom with light, and fireflies gather wherever it rests.
codekin.name: Sylvanox
codekin.rumor: Spotted near parks & gardens at dusk or night, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: A storm with a serpent's shape. It is said to swim through the city's cables at night, lighting them up.
codekin.name: Arcwyrm
codekin.rumor: Spotted near apps & tech and wi-fi codes at night, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: A range of mountains walks on its back. Where it lies down to sleep, maps have to be redrawn.
codekin.name: Gaiadon
codekin.rumor: Spotted near map pins & places and travel at midday, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: Rides the edge of every storm that crosses the ocean. Travelers who spot it from shore make a wish.
codekin.name: Tempestra
codekin.rumor: Spotted near travel at dawn or dusk, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: A shadow that carries an eclipse on its back. When it calls, every streetlight in the city dims.
codekin.name: Umbralis
codekin.rumor: Spotted near cryptic codes and websites at night, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: Glides above concerts and fireworks on wings of light. Every color in the show is borrowed from it.
codekin.name: Prismara
codekin.rumor: Spotted near events & tickets and video & music at dusk, by trainers of rank 15 and up. It never stays in one place.

codekin.flavor: Born from a corrupted code that was scanned a million times. It surfaces only where the signal is weakest.
codekin.name: Glitchbit
codekin.rumor: They say it only surfaces from broken codes, when every clock reads 3.

codekin.flavor: Said to be the first code ever scanned, still waiting to be read. Its three finder squares never stop turning.
codekin.name: Omnicode
codekin.rumor: Some say it waits for a trainer who has found every kind of code.

codekin.flavor: An echo of every visit to the same place. Return often enough, and one day it will be waiting.
codekin.name: Echoveil
codekin.rumor: It answers only those who return to the same code, day after day, for a week.
